description: Every commitment with its attributes — price now, cycle, status, category, member, account — plus its next unpaid charge, how many charges it has, and how far it is planned. Plans running short are named. `active` is what still lies ahead: a one-time commitment whose charge is behind today or paid is a charge now, counted in settled_one_time and read with charges. direction flags money in ("in") and a movement between the owner's own accounts ("transfer"). Amounts are per-currency and never converted, blended, or amortised.
name: commitments
title: List commitments
